description: Real ENT claims of the live evaluation of 2026-10-25 over dotnet-architecture/eShopModernizing at 63bc9ec4, trimmed to id, card type, card title, claim text, status and citations.

claims.text: Table Catalog maps to entity CatalogItem with primary key Id; Id is required and the database generation is turned off (values come from the hi-lo generator).
Column Catalog.CatalogBrandId: int, NOT NULL, foreign key to CatalogBrand.Id (required relationship).
Column Catalog.CatalogTypeId: int, NOT NULL, foreign key to CatalogType.Id (required relationship).
Service methods operate on CatalogItem and reference CatalogBrand and CatalogType (e.g., Include in queries, GetCatalogBrands/Types).
The class is generic over TEntity, which must be a reference type, and exposes ActualPage, ItemsPerPage, TotalItems and Data with private setters, so they are set only through the constructor.
